parameters.name: AppName
parameters.description: The app name. Leave empty to match all names.

parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description: The live streaming domain (primary playback domain).

parameters.name: Order
parameters.description:
The sort order. Valid values:

- **asc** (default): ascending order.

- **desc**: descending order.

parameters.name: PageNum
parameters.description: The current page number. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The page size. Default value: 10. Valid values: 5 to 30.

parameters.name: StreamName
parameters.description: The live stream name. Leave empty to match all stream names.
